title: Raku Party
source_quote: October 7 - 4PM Introductory Price $150. Call now or book by October 6.
evidence_sentence: The Raku Party page describes a workshop where participants glaze a piece and watch it fired in a traditional raku kiln.
evidence_quote: you glaze your chosen piece and watch it fired in a traditional Raku kiln
summary: A raku firing workshop for 4–10 participants where you glaze a pre-made bisque piece, watch the firing, and help unload. Dinner is catered. This October 7 date has passed.
commitment: Evening event (5PM start, duration ~3–4 hours based on description)
bring: Participants select from pre-made bisque pieces; safety gear provided
